programme.title: 中華賭俠粵普
programme.desc: 香港賭王阿酷一度風光無限,以一手飛牌絕技名震江湖,在亞洲只有日本的鐵男可堪與其一戰,阿酷也一心想擊敗鐵男,成爲真正的亞洲第一人爲了這頂頭銜,他苦練賭術,心無旁騖,卻在此時被自己的義兄楊光陷害

programme.title: 雙截棍普
programme.desc: 本片講述的是由陳天星飾演的電影動作導演東方哲深受世界功夫巨星李小龍的影響,決心要自編自導自演一部雙截棍電影來向李小龍宗師致敬因沉溺於雙截棍劇作的東方哲不能自拔,導致家庭破裂,妻子離定出走,兒子離奇失踪

programme.title: 黃大仙烏鼠粵普
programme.desc: 督察符永琳因貪污被檢控, 往法庭途中越押, 逃回大陸, 被列作一號通緝犯兩名女幹探前往調查符的案件, 兩個當年被符屈打成招的青年無意中碰上符, 決意報仇四人被符鎖進一幢大廈內, 以便一一解決在緊要關頭公安特種部隊從天而降

programme.title: 野獸之瞳粵
programme.desc: 賀瞳(古天樂 飾)和賀沖(吳彥祖 飾)是一對關係疏離的孿生兄弟哥哥阿瞳是一個活潑外向的聰明孩子,而沖則完全相反,害羞內向在他二十六歲生日那天,沖收到了哥哥去世的消息,驚詫的他開始調查哥哥的神秘死亡在阿瞳的家裏,沖遇上了瞳生前的女友阿陸(谷祖琳 飾)和最好的朋友阿Man(譚耀文 飾)沖最終發現瞳的死是因為在一場拳擊比賽中拒絕打假拳日子漸長,沖漸漸喜歡上阿陸,而與此同時開始着手為哥哥的

programme.title: 財神到粵普
programme.desc: 財神到分為三個不同的故事,財神總管奉命散財,派遣兩位財神下凡,嗜酒財神化身為十歲的女孩小嬌,把一億元送給善心的教師楊素娟;女財神為了給予盲人鋼琴家一塊錢,在日夕相處之下對他動了凡心財神總管親自下凡,遇上了傾慕公司太子爺的倒楣上班族OL徐傑與她的好友董晶晶,究竟失憶和失去法力

programme.title: 失業皇帝粵普
programme.desc: 集團總監拒絕包庇好色歛財的太子爺,被公司解僱適逢百業蕭條,羅連低微的工作也找不上幸得敬業的乞丐相救,羅運用其機智在行乞大業上得到可觀的回報一日羅遇上對他憐憫的少女,他決意展開追求,亦發誓要

programme.title: 戀戰沖繩粵
programme.desc: 一個叫Jenny(王菲飾)的女人某天醒來,發覺她不再愛枕邊的黑幫頭目佐藤(加滕雅也飾),她帶走了他的一袋錢,那是佐藤準備從大賊唐傑(張國榮飾)手中贖回寫滿了黑幫秘密的私人日記的贖金手緊的唐傑得不到錢,卻遇上與女友(黎姿飾)來沖繩玩的休假刑警羅宏達(梁家輝飾)達決心緝捕唐,過程中,兩個男人都喜歡了這飄忽的女人,達更為此而放棄相戀多年的女朋友,從未為女人付出過認真感情的唐與Jenny展開一場

programme.title: 瘦身男女粵
programme.desc: Mini (鄭秀文飾) 是旅居日本的香港人,原本她是一名窈窕美女,但她在鋼琴家男友黑川到美國留學後,卻因孤獨貪吃逐漸變成了一個體重260磅的大肥婆黑川學成歸來在日本各地陸續舉辦了多場鋼琴音樂會,Mini儘管每次都到場觀看,但是黑川已經認不出她了這讓Mini非常自卑想要在旅館上吊自殺,被旅館女老闆阻止,並認識了在此旅館暫住的有相似體形卻過的很開心的肥佬 (劉德華飾) --他也是名旅居日本的

programme.title: 明月幾時有粵
programme.desc: 以東江縱隊生死大營救事件為敘事線索,講述以香港傳奇女性方姑為代表的仁人志士,在1940年亂世中的香港展開生死救援的故事影片由一系列黑白片段串聯而成以一位年邁的抗戰老兵鄭家彬梁家輝飾的回憶貫穿全片日軍佔領香港後,為了讓身在英屬香港的茅盾,鄒韜奮,夏衍等多位中國文化名人乘船逃回中國內地,以劉黑仔為主要代表的抗日短槍隊成員積極擔負起這些名人的安全轉移任務茅盾夫婦由於租住在教師方蘭家裏,方蘭

programme.title: 沒有小鳥的天空粵普
programme.desc: 阿仁遇上意外,生命危在旦夕,醫生搶救失敗後,從其身上找到一張器官捐贈證, card上註明可捐出生殖器官全部患了老人癡呆症的仁母沒有法定權力,固香港政府授權執行移植手術天意弄人,阿仁竟然在殮房內死而復生這次復生卻為他帶來比死更痛苦的打擊

programme.title: 雙瞳普
programme.desc: 臺北市接連發生恐怖殺人案,化工大亨廖振富,女模丘妙芳,美國籍的基督新教信理會牧師羅倫佐(Lorenzo)被害,由於案情實在過於離奇,且過去從未有過類似的連環命案,中華民國政府因此請求美國聯邦調查局(FBI)的協助,FBI便派遣凱文·萊澈(Kevin Richter)探員來臺出差,凱文指定臺北市警察局外國事務組(外事組)的警員黃火土前來陪同調查nn先前,黃火土因揭發同事蔡榮源貪污,害蔡榮源被

programme.title: 重口味粵普
programme.desc: 顏千民和邱月清兩位大學生學校宿舍床位不足,搬到了紅燈區的一所大樓,而這座大樓裡住的都是妓女,他二人也因此被電視報導二人想近水樓台先得月的嫖一次,卻出現各種狀況千民邂逅了甘做他人小三的林保怡,並深深地愛上了她,將保怡當做意淫對象

programme.title: 打工狂想曲粵普
programme.desc: Becky, Angie, Candy是典型白領儷人一日,Angie在公司發現一大袋金牛,後三人將錢運走原來該款是經理大維,貪污被人勒索的掩口費唐著令保安經理Albert查出真相,事情發展出人意表,結局又是另一驚訝意外

programme.title: 密室逃生
programme.desc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。

programme.desc: 兩個立志成為網紅的男生連同一位漂亮女同學,合力在學校後面的舊大樓拍一部靈異實錄片,希望能吸引更多關注。三人遇上校內霸凌同學的富二代男女。原來女同學早已有計劃接近這幾個學校霸凌,籍此展開一場不惜犧牲無辜

programme.title: The Possession of Leah Dela Cruz (Ang Pagsanib kay Leah Dela Cruz)
programme.desc: 一名女警搬進小鎮後不久,便被一宗少女疑似遭邪靈附身的案件所牽引。隨著調查層層深入,詭譎真相逐漸浮現,現實與靈異的界線愈發模糊,她亦一步步墜入危機之中。最終,她發現這不僅是一場驅魔之戰,更是一段揭開小鎮

programme.desc: 冠軍賽慘遭擊倒後,泰拳女拳手自昏迷中甦醒,卻發現自己被困於一片由塵封恐懼滋生的夢魘之地。在神祕青年的引導下,她以故鄉的呵叻流泰拳迎戰內心的惡念,穿越層層幻象的搏殺,重新尋回自我。

programme.title: Creepy Pasta
programme.desc: 一名年輕男子被困在一座廢棄的房子裡,拼命要尋找自己被困的線索。原來真相隱藏在連串被瘋傳的影片內,而這些影像亦逐漸影響了他的思想…

programme.title: 凌晨三點鐘 - 醫院
programme.desc: 一個被送院治療的女人,意外發現老公出軌。精神瀕臨崩潰的她一直被一個“陌生人幹擾,而他也自稱為這婚外情的另一受害者。這“陌生人究竟是幻覺還是惡靈? 在她竭力控制自己的思緒和行為當下,能否制止自己傷

programme.title: Chapter 1 Mae Nak Reborn
programme.desc: 鬼妻娜娜再次回歸,為一名遭受性侵導致流產的孕婦報仇。除鬼妻娜娜外,沒有人能認出襲擊者的身份。娜娜為報仇變成厲鬼,並要懲罰襲擊者的惡行。

programme.title: 夜迷藏
programme.desc: 電影由三個恐怖短故事組成:一個男人收到死神通報後,設法避過死亡;男人因心愛的妻子去世後傷心欲絕,他的妻子變成鬼魂與他通靈;三兄弟在一次晚餐聚會上為照顧年邁母親的問題而爭吵,最後竟變成一宗可怕的謀殺案。

programme.title: 模範家庭
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開…

programme.title: Night at the Eagle Inn
programme.desc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: 潘辰是泰國一處偏僻的村莊裡受眾人敬仰和有名氣的靈媒。她希望她的姪女小普保有處女之身,以繼承她村內靈媒的地位。然而,當小普愛上青梅竹馬的圖恩後,靈界的秘密被揭開,他們的性命也面臨威脅。

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…

programme.title: 鐵扇公主
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒西行取經,受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山,唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事,牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後,師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精,悟空再施神通,護師脫險。

programme.title: 如來神掌
programme.desc: 年輕龍劍飛武功低劣,但在一次偶然的機會下,被火魂邪神古漢魂收為義子,並獲傳授八式如來神掌。龍劍飛從此脫胎換骨,成為武林高手。為報師仇,古漢魂命龍劍飛下山替他找仇人報仇,江湖風暴遂再牽起…

programme.title: 邪鬥邪
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海,由於欠債累累無力償還,遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破,並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭,可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯,老伯答應給餘巨額現金,只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸

programme.title: 洪拳與詠春
programme.desc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺,殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子,分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下,學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人,並為死去師兄弟報仇。

programme.title: 何日君再來
programme.desc: 富家子卓明不顧父親反對,與歌女雪玲結婚,並因此與家庭斷絕關係。婚後,雪玲懷孕,卓明因過度勞累導致視力衰退。為維持家計,雪玲重操舊業登台演唱,而卓明不願拖累妻子,選擇悄然離開。在友人鼓勵下,雪玲再次公開獻唱,卓明深受感動,最終與妻兒重逢。

programme.title: 文素臣
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察,他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按,幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇,林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺,聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。

programme.title: 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課,隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍,而林又發現珍常被男老師追求,期間笑料百出。

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰,在賭館當巡場;一夜,十虎的徒弟及後人等四人,在賭場相聚時,旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲,把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等,昔日曾把父殺死,以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手,殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人,為父報仇

programme.title: 相思河畔
programme.desc: 富商之子馮琪偉戀上歌女方碧玉,碧玉身世凄涼,常受流氓頭子林老二及李老三壓榨勒索,幸得琪偉相助並娶之為妻。婚後二人育一子,惜李老三再度敲詐,最終琪偉為愛妻討回公道而與李老三同歸於盡

programme.title: 目無王法
programme.desc: 何中衡、秦英豪及羅正三個初出茅廬的捕快,秉除暴安良,維護法紀之宗旨,盡力撲滅罪行,縣中賭館妓院,均遭掃蕩。三人因堅拒與貪贓枉法的縣官與捕頭同流合污,而慘被陷害

programme.title: 大醉俠
programme.desc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走,幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助,從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。

programme.title: 劍女幽魂
programme.desc: 劍聖女兒霍小芬受命將早前被盜的鎮國之寶金龍寶劍送回京師,途中卻遭玉面童子爪牙截擊和毒害身亡。小芬為報此仇,藉寶劍靈氣還魂,竭盡全力把金龍寶劍送返京師,更成功將玉面童子消滅。最後她把劍親手送交皇上,升天而去。

programme.title: 傾國傾城
programme.desc: 李翰祥史詩式電影,藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后;處女演出即成名的蕭瑤,飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃;而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。

programme.title: 小雲雀
programme.desc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 小雲雀
programme.desc: 記者仕泰爲發掘歌星小雲雀的秘密,假扮大亨接近小雲雀。後來仕泰的假大亨身份被揭穿,小雲雀大怒,請來真正大亨揭穿仕泰的身份。怎料大亨很欣賞仕泰的應變能力,實時聘請他爲助手,處理歌星登台事宜。

programme.title: 十二金牌
programme.desc: 南宋年間,朝廷腐敗積弱,加上金兵南侵,民生困苦。一代名將岳飛赤膽忠肝,率領岳家軍奮勇抗敵,大破金兵,深受百姓愛戴。宋朝丞相秦檜賣國求榮,勾結金國四王子金兀术,設計對付岳飛,以掃除金人入侵中原的最大阻礙。宋高宗為保帝位,縱容秦檜隻手遮天,更聽從其讒言發出十二道金牌急召岳飛回京。岳飛長子岳雲、次子岳雷與

programme.title: 鑽石艷盜
programme.desc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?

programme.title: 笑傲江湖
programme.desc: 華山派大弟子令狐沖要找出一個繼承「笑傲江湖」琴譜的人。當令狐沖發現任盈盈為合適人選時,卻發現她竟是魔教教主任我行之女,同時他亦一步步捲入正邪兩道的權鬥陰謀和道義兩難的困境。

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!

programme.title: 馬哥波羅
programme.desc: 故事描述東遊至中國的馬哥波羅,聽從元世祖忽必烈忠告,到中國各地考察三年,回京後,適逢忽遭反元志士刺殺,幸得蒙古高手護駕,一死一逃;馬憑死者遺言,判斷餘黨必在揚州;馬被任命為總督,率兵將反元者一網打盡;惟馬抵揚後,有感於漢人抗異族的無比決心,遂將蒙兵來攻之事暗告反元志士

programme.title: 倩女幽魂
programme.desc: 年輕書生寧采臣在傳說鬧鬼的恐怖寺廟裡過夜。雖然他不相信傳聞,卻遇上美麗的女鬼聶小倩。原來聶小倩被困在寺廟中,誘使年輕男子給魔頭姥姥享用。寧采臣得悉聶小倩為一隻善良的女鬼,於是決定助她逃離魔掌。

programme.title: 武林風雲
programme.desc: 故事描述,武義親王恃勢弄權,為奪紫光劍,不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧,並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡,借弔祭為名,實以武力奪劍。甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際,表親徐進到訪,聯手殺退惡奴,但大戰中,徐進、勝男等受傷,無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵……

programme.title: 軍閥趣史
programme.desc: 此片可謂李翰祥導演,經典作《大軍閥》之延續,焦點在幾位當時得令的豔星,餘莎莉、邵音音及楚湘雲。片中「豔趣」特別多…

programme.title: 保鏢
programme.desc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力,於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中,他們遇到了一名神秘俠客,三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪,竭力保護黃金不被劫走。

programme.title: 鱷魚河
programme.desc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。

programme.title: 鍾馗娘子
programme.desc: 鍾馗娘子被邪惡的黑金剛擊敗後,隱居多年,處心積慮要復仇。女俠翠屏勇猛堅毅,為剷除黑金剛,懇求鍾馗娘子收她為徒。娘子與翠屏兩師徒聯手對付黑金剛,也是他大限將至的時侯。

programme.title: 城寨出來者
programme.desc: 因為九龍城寨被拆, 這部電影隨即被譽為不能重拍的經典。 江湖動作片中少有地拍出倫理片的感人兄弟情故事, 最後一場困獸式的死亡搏鬥, 以手提攝影機拍出瘋狂與悲涼, 被大特寫雜誌選為當年十大電影。

programme.title: 人皮燈籠
programme.desc: 趙春方曾於決鬥敗於龍帥之手下。七年後,龍帥為在賞燈大會上奪魁,往尋趙春方代為製造別緻燈籠。趙春方藉此暗中佈下復仇大計。龍帥之妻無固失蹤後,他驚聞有關人皮燈籠的傳說,並開始懷疑趙春方與失蹤事件有關

programme.title: 藍與黑
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路

programme.title: 藍與黑
programme.desc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路

programme.title: 女校春色
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。

programme.title: 五毒
programme.desc: 蜈蚣功的鹿峰、蛇功的韋白、蠍子功的孫建、壁虎功的郭追、蛤蟆功的羅莽,各擅勝場,不同型格。電影風格奇特,一開始五毒門清理門戶,派出楊得將五個高手就地正法。同出師門,卻受師父追殺,有人說是喻他一手建立的張家班命运,張徹拍出殺戮的悲劇,沒有他慣常的大義浩然,卻有天地不容的毀滅性。

programme.title: 鳳還巢
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易,庶室程夫人既憤且惱,對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥,催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡,嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久,趁此良機冒充居易,依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角,配搭新鮮;而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出,更令人笑破肚皮。

programme.title: 盜劍
programme.desc: 韓九重為奪削鐵如泥的青霜劍,誘殺師弟談鶴鳴;談鶴鳴的妻子耿六娘隱姓埋名在將軍府為傭,伺機奪劍報仇。將軍女兒嬌龍拜六娘為師,練成一身武藝,並與六娘師侄羅翼虎相戀。翼虎順嬌龍之意,深夜到親王府盜劍,然而寡不敵眾,失手被擒;嬌龍率眾營救,與韓九重等人展開連場激戰。

programme.title: 錯點鴛鴦
programme.desc: 任職推銷員的余小寶失戀後,遇上剛剛跟男友分手的富家女金金。二人同病相憐,很快便墜入愛河並閃電結婚,開展甜蜜的生活。可惜,此時金金卻發現自己懷上了前男友的骨肉

programme.title: 來如風
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾,駕崩在即,卻無子可繼帝位;皇侄世子傑本可繼位,惜不成器,難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一,現時藏匿于東陽縣,遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺,幸得俠士來如風相助

programme.title: 雙喜臨門
programme.desc: 朱國棟和李明珠本打算結婚,無奈雙方父母為多年死對頭,所以堅決反對婚事。於是二人不惜假裝自殺。有見及此雙方家長最終冰釋前嫌,答應二人成婚。此時,唱片公司宣佈會為出棟的歌曲版,最終可謂雙喜臨門。

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面,又無利益衝突,無須決鬥,猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是,他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚,卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀…

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境,與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局,並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中,她為躲避海關查緝,急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上,卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下,芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀,試圖奪回戒指。

programme.title: 插翅難飛
programme.desc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手,遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者,高明說出乃黑豹所為後,即被開槍殺死,鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇,卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾;同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫,欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落,但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名,從未見其人,究竟黑豹是誰?

programme.title: 女巡按
programme.desc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救

programme.title: 奪魂鈴

programme.title: 碧血劍

programme.title: 天蠶變

programme.title: 鐵血陽泉
programme.desc: 1947年隨著炮火不斷推進,陽泉獲得解放,中國共產黨在一片廢墟上建立了第一座人民城市。全片以建設城市為主線,以清除敵特和個人情感為副線,敘寫了為全國其他城市解放建市提供借鑒的陽泉解放建市歷程。

programme.title: 飛鴻笑傳
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻年少時期頑皮搞怪,在父親黃麒英面前卻恭恭敬敬規規矩矩的。黃麒英教飛鴻功夫,飛鴻總是利用小聰明借機偷懶,所以飛鴻的功夫只能是半桶水。黃麒英因為醫館繁忙,也沒有太多時間去管束飛鴻。n 飛鴻雖然頑皮,卻有一顆俠義心腸。一次街市上看到幾個

programme.title: 女神捕之迷局
programme.desc: 清朝末年,江南一帶乾旱成災,一時間餓殍遍野,百姓民不聊生。此時,曹化之貪污“兩河工程款一案,在京城和坊間引起巨大反響,百姓痛恨,皇宮震驚。皇上傳出諭旨,責令京城都察院限期破案。皇宮裡九侯爺暗中散佈消息,說曹化之越獄逃跑。女捕快鐵飛花立下軍

programme.desc: 該片以1940年初侵華日軍重兵偷襲八路軍前線總指揮部的危急時刻,時任八路軍三八六旅參謀長周希漢抗命救駕的史實及一段情緣為依據,真誠的展現了大智大勇、敢作敢為、鐵骨柔腸的一代戰將周希漢——中國的巴頓。

programme.title: 半個喜劇

programme.title: 銀杏之夢

programme.title: 東宮毒
programme.desc: 龍重九——二十三歲,御醫世家第九子,人稱“九郎,男身女相,美貌無雙。柳非春——二十歲,一門忠烈為國戰死沙場,因此特許以女兒身進禁軍任職,“娘炮神醫與“吃貨女漢子闖蕩江湖、救人治世的爆笑經歷。

programme.desc: 本劇通過主人翁王二江在查吧等候女友時,巧合幫助前來交贖金的開發商劉祥的妻子,同時也配合公安人員將罪犯抓獲,拿回贖金,從而得到了一份保安的工作。n在花園社區做保安時,由於自己樸實的品德和對工作的格外熱情在對住戶劉克棟、肖芒的一家、住戶汪局長

programme.desc: 三名中國商人在俄羅斯被殺害。雷霄等人發現新世紀夜總會老闆杜元海有殺人嫌疑。不料,杜卻在這時候死了。在中俄警方的努力下,抓獲了殺害中國商人的罪犯。策劃殺害杜元海的真凶亦浮出水面,竟然是杜元海的妻子。

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #2 英普
programme.desc: 喀拉哈里的動物們渴望雨水,因為牠們已經忍受了極端乾旱的一年見證象群在拼命尋找水源時的合作,邂逅幫助小貓鼬生存的奇怪保姆

programme.title: 喀拉哈里: 秘密聯盟 #3 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨到達喀拉哈里沙漠的科學家並驗證一個假設:動物合作是該地區爆發物種多樣性的關鍵觀察他們監控行為,破譯數據,並得出引人入勝的結論

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #5 英普
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗:這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能

programme.title: 非洲野狗:族群對獅群 #4
programme.desc: 跟隨來自ZCP的朱爾茲和亨利一起追跡卡昆比幼崽,目睹牠們與一隻倔强的,長著獠牙的疣豬之間的對峙,過程中還會邂逅一頭大象跟隨ZCP的獅子專家珊迪·穆維特瓦(Thandie Mwetwa),他正在統計將曼齊族群趕出領地的獅群

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #1 英普
programme.desc: 南非的春天從9月初開始,大自然變得生氣盎 然日照變長,氣溫上升,動植物緊密合作繁殖,生育和養育幼兒

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2 英普
programme.desc: 非洲的夏天是一個極端的季節,它汰弱留強,測試了獵豹,獅子,大守宮,烏龜和許多其他物種在夏季極端炎熱時覓食和尋找水源的生存本能

programme.title: 深潛北美 #5
programme.desc: 參與莉茲最驚險刺激的大西洋任務--與公牛鯊進行自由潛水探索充滿神秘氛圍的墨西哥灣濕地沼澤,那裡棲息著飢餓的鱷魚,機敏的鱷龜,還有雖然細小卻無比強韌的沙丘老鼠,牠們的存在對維持海岸穩固起著不可或缺的作用

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #1
programme.desc: 齊來認識小熊溫斯頓,這隻被遺棄的幼熊與茱蒂建立了深厚的羈絆,因為得到她全天候的照顧感受茱蒂如何忍痛切斷彼此的情感連結,並教導這個可愛的小傢伙,如何在沒有人類的野外世界,成為獨當一面的黑熊

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #2
programme.desc: 歡迎姐妹檔西巴,西拉和索拉,這三隻挨餓的孤兒讓溫斯頓的世界天翻地覆,直到溫柔的索拉教會溫斯頓友誼的意義然後關注新來的幼熊雅思敏和雅拉,牠們在經歷驚險的分離後重新相聚

programme.title: 成為大象:瑞提提的孤兒們 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​在道別的傷痛與對未來的希望之間尋求平衡,因為這一代被救援的大象,終於迎來了重返自由的時刻歡迎瑞特提大家庭的新成員:一頭從水坑中被救出的象寶寶,以及一匹名叫奇希瑪的斑馬,牠曾因創傷而驚恐不安

programme.title: 農場野生物語 #1 英普

programme.desc: 與朱爾茲(Julz)一起尋找難以捉摸的曼齊族群,這個族群剛剛失去了四只寶貴的幼崽,在此過程中見證一場獅子與鬣狗的對決然後跟隨尚比亞食肉動物項目的亨利(Henry)一起前往卡昆比巢穴來一次家訪,那裡又有一隻幼崽不知所蹤

programme.title: 超獸 #6

programme.title: 明猩學園 #9
programme.desc: 工作人員正計劃下一輪釋放行動,而學園內的幾名準畢業生前途未卜經過九個月,迪娜分娩的時刻到了,但卻出了亂子,新家庭的未來變得不確定

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #2 英普
programme.desc: 母獅們出發尋找正在獵捕水牛的雄獅,為此她們必須穿越鱷魚出沒的河流跟隨姆萬巴獅群中唯一的幼獅米洛,見證他如何在脫離險境,並成為延續家族未來的希望

programme.title: 非洲獵人 #3 英普
programme.desc: 如果小小的恩塞富獅群想要生存下去,族群中一對不合群的兄弟必須迅速掌握狩獵技巧,並要快速穿梭於敵人領地中,與霸氣的競爭對手和強大的鬣狗群作戰,以得着溫飽

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #4 英普

programme.title: 熊寶貝訓練營 #1

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #1 英普

programme.title: 美國在野四季錄 #2 英普

programme.title: 深潛北美 #5
programme.desc: 參與莉茲最驚險刺激的大西洋任務--與公牛鯊進行自由潛水探索充滿神秘氛圍的墨西哥灣濕地沼澤,那裡棲息著飢餓的鱷魚,機敏的鱷龜,還有雖然細小卻無比強韌的沙丘老鼠,牠們的存在對維持海岸穩固起著不可或缺的作用

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #4
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵訪世上最大的城市之一上海,他在當地發現一個現代化,國際化,全球化的城市

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #5
programme.desc: 崇明在透過美食探索中國歷史的旅程中,來到山東-孔子的故鄉,也是中國最古老和最有影響力的烹飪傳統源地之一

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #6
programme.desc: 廖崇明抵達中國最迷人的省份之一-雲南 充滿了來自東南亞和中亞的香料和芬芳,各地的中國人都愛上這裡的美食和文化

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #7

programme.title: 美味走透透:中國 #8
programme.desc: 廖崇明身在福建,當地是一個有著悠久移民歷史的地方,他們遷移所留下的持久痕跡,體現在其飲食和文化上

programme.title: 成名之旅 #2
programme.desc: 專訪與羅賓威廉斯在《暴雨驕陽》聯合主演的基爾漢臣,《外星驕客》編劇大衛米施,好友兼喜劇演員域克奧華頓等人

programme.title: 成名之旅 #3
programme.desc: 專訪金凱瑞的《變相怪傑》導演漆黑羅素,《鴨子工廠》聯合主演德蘭間素,《月亮上的男人》監製米高候斯曼等人

programme.title: 成名之旅 #4
programme.desc: 專訪雪兒《施活的遭遇》導演米高候斯曼,神尼及雪兒經理哈維克斯基,影評人柯克懇尼咳等

programme.title: 野外的一年:約克郡 #2
programme.desc: 反常的寒冷夏天令約克郡谷地和北約克沼澤國家公園的幾種動物生活艱難,其中包括一隻受傷的西方狍和她的雙胞胎

programme.title: 野外的一年:約克郡 #3
programme.desc: 夏季持續,秋天暫且未到,出人意料的宜人天氣為西方狍們提供了一條救命稻草,因牠們正為即將到來的冬季做準備至於其他動物,交配季節已到,在文斯卡海灘充滿了睪酮的氣息

programme.title: 野外的一年:約克郡 #4
programme.desc: 儘管冬季遲來,但對文斯卡海灘的灰海豹來說,冬天就代表著分娩的時間新生的幼崽現正快速步入成年,在牠們的母親繼續前行前,只有三周的時間來盡量增加體重

programme.title: 海獵人 #1
programme.desc: 每年春天,在挪威海域,鯨魚會運用一種聰明的捕獵技巧--氣泡網捕食來捕捉大量鯡魚當牠們發現魚群時,便開始包圍獵物,並不斷釋放氣泡形成一道空氣幕牆,將魚群困在其中

programme.title: 海獵人 #2
programme.desc: 海洋生物學家伊芙・朱爾丹與理察・考利奧森,已在挪威研究虎鯨兩年之久,觀察牠們如何將旋轉圍捕技巧適應於當地環境

programme.title: 海獵人 #3
programme.desc: 在深海之中,敏捷迅速的海獅展現驚人的水下動作,以智取敵人在巴塔哥尼亞的海灘上,一隻幼海獅正學習遊泳,而掠食者已悄然準備發動致命攻擊

programme.title: 海獵人 #4
programme.desc: 好望角塘鵝是強悍的獵手,翱翔海岸尋找最愛的獵物--沙丁魚群,並等待一位意想不到的盟友:海豚的協助

programme.title: 海獵人 #5
programme.desc: 在好望角十字角炙熱的陽光下,大批海豹群聚於納米比亞骷髏海岸雄性海豹體重可達 360 公斤,巡守領域以保護雌性與幼崽然而,新的陸地掠食者正逼近,迫使牠們學習全新的防禦行為

programme.title: 海獵人 #6
programme.desc: 在巴塔哥尼亞瓦爾德斯半島的中心,鯨魚經常遭到一種體型嬌小卻意圖兇殘的掠食者襲擊--海鷗牠們迫使鯨魚潛入深海,遠離賴以生存的氧氣與光線

programme.title: 非凡工程 2 #2

Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.desc: Alyse Edwards continues her journey in the Turkish town of Alacati Starting inland she explores some of the remains of ancient civilisations and experiences some incredible views of Alacati and the surrounding areas After a brief stop off for some exquisite wine, she heads to the nearby coastal town of Cesme for some further exploring and puts herself to the test by having a go at the famous local sport of Wind Surfing

programme.title: Essence Of India
programme.desc: The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries nnHere is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets nnThis episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world

programme.desc: Doused in heritage with old hamlets, drowsy villages and towns studding its lush green hills, Southern France’s Occitania region only officially come into being in 2016 with the pairing of Languedoc-Roussillon and the Midi-Pyrenees The two historically Occitan regions are blessed with colour, tranquility, and a wealth of UNESCO World Heritage Sites Food and drink are still approached with reverence in the region, and a whistle stop tour around four different departments of the Midi Pyrenees; Tarn, Gers, Tarn-et-Garonne and Haute Garonne gives you plenty of opportunity to experience some of its best gastronomy, as Katy Dartford discovers

programme.desc: Samira is in New York, getting ready for an exciting trip back home to India, where she re-visits Indian cuisine with her New York culinary trained eye She packs her bags and sets off nnNew York’s signature street food is the hot dog In India, street food is a highly developed cuisine all on its own, going back hundreds of years Samira has her own take on the shammi kabab and turns them into mini burgers in her kitchen, before traipsing all over New Delhi in her Essence of India auto rickshaw devouring the hearty Samosa, the succulent Kathi wraps, the moorishly moist Biryanis and even ends up taking over a street cart with a smorgasbord of sweet, tangy and spicy Indian chaat

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:幸虧我還有神 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:李盛林牧師-出埃及記
programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。n雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。n流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血、淚、性命寫成的感人見證!n今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢?n李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 美東華人差傳大會 破繭齊出 同頌主榮
programme.desc: 每年,美國基督教界都有一個大型特會,由基督使者協會主辦,超過3000位不同經驗、背景與年齡的與會者一同參與,有來自世界各地的講員主講,那就是華人差傳大會。在美東華人差傳大會,有陳恩藩牧師(Francis Chan)和Bob Sjogren(《貓狗神學大不同》作者)等主講,美國創世電視輯錄十個精彩的專

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列

programme.title: IMPACTS: Climates Change the World

programme.title: Ukiyoe EDO-LIFE: Summer Delicacy

programme.title: Hometown Stories

programme.title: Satoyama Kitchen Summer #6

programme.title: Japanology Plus
programme.desc: Mamachari bikes, which originated in Japan, are designed to meet the needs of all kinds of people They even helped women enter the workforce We discover what makes them so unique and special

programme.title: NHK NEWSLINE

高朋滿座#150粵
programme.desc: 悅利用驗孕棒，得知懷孕。高家紛紛獻計安胎，亦多照顧悅。滿載幸福的悅獲美容集團的主席馬太看上，要她成為瘦身代言人。除付上百萬酬金外，更安排悅得非凡照顧和享受。但一次意外，眾人竟發現身孕之事只是一場誤會。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#25粵普PG
programme.desc: 謝危夢到當年之事，雪寧從謝危的夢囈猜到其身分，又為了保護謝危而驅趕闖入的野貓，謝危醒來後吻雪寧；謝危矯詔讓燕牧父子接管燕家軍，在邊城與他們相認；大月行為反常，謝危懷疑他們與人勾結，獨自赴約見大月王子。

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 今集的菜單有三餸一湯，「紅酒腩排」之外，「野葛菜生魚羅漢果湯」營養豐富兼有清熱解毒、滋陰活血等功效，值得推介。重頭菜式「上湯原鍋焗多寶魚」製法超級簡單！肥媽還自家炮製加入港式用料的「韓國芝士炒年糕」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 醫學專題新節目《重症解密》已首播，來自「重症調查科」的譚俊彥、陳曉華、林秀怡、梁凱晴到臨細談拍攝點滴；凱晴觀察微創切胃手術後覺得神奇？四人在現實中又會如何注重健康？結膜是覆蓋眼瞼內側與眼白表面的薄膜，或會因病毒、致敏原、化學物質刺激而引起發炎；眼科醫生提醒夏日嬉水會增加結膜炎風險，為甚麼？醫生指會根據發炎的成因對症下藥，預防關鍵則是良好的個人衛生習慣。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐奉上「鯪魚肉釀芥菜心」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃深圳粵
programme.desc: 星級中菜館供應多款精緻美點，蝦餃滲出淡淡藤椒麻味、菠蘿包可吃到新鮮菠蘿蓉，脆叉燒口感一絕！鐵板燒包含十一道菜，「團購價」只需三百多元人民幣，即可嚐味和牛、鵝肝等，食得精明。火鍋餐廳讓大家實現「海鮮自由」，鮑魚、蟹、蝦等任撈任食。主持大讚價格實惠，到底收費如何？「吃貨」轉戰人氣連鎖超市即買即試，草莓、榴槤千層蛋糕等大熱貨品，全都無伏？慧中、凱晴寬衣享受椰子熱油Spa；而在深圳還可覓得泰式Cafe。

programme.title: 才駿HASHTAG 「私人財富」─ 財富+粵

programme.title: 東坡家事#12粵PG
programme.desc: 季常被坊眾指指點點；大妹帶他回蘇家暫住。少游入贅蘇家，小妹三難新郎。解決小妹的難題時，突聞月娥咆哮，眾趕到發現季常衣衫不整，大妹瑟縮在床。東坡要季常休妻再娶，月娥狀告東坡教唆親妹勾引季常，驚動聖駕……

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 戴雅一行目擊一顆類似流星的光球，這跟導致他們穿越時空的光球一模一樣，繼而決定找出光球墜落的地方。就在搜索途中，他們再次成為肉食恐龍的獵物！三人能否逃出生天，找到光球，回到原來的時代呢？

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 每位到來零食廠的小兵都各有特長，今回，一名薯片女兵即使在「廠長話」的熱身賽接連失誤，但當轉到淘汰賽，她卻是留守至最後的一人！曲奇隊某男兵則有另一強項，他兩次推出「魔法地壺」，就輕鬆地收集到兩款指定食材。在此小遊戲中，薯片隊兩名女將確是稍稍欠缺力度，只能將一卷健康零食秘笈拱手相讓。來到「溶化之橋」任務，薯片女兵又再活躍起來，她們每次皆要求運送六球雪糕，更能穩定兼快速地完成，果然兩隊都有隱藏的實力！

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 細菌人企圖搶別人食物的時候，鐵火小卷妹妹與玉露茶人先後來到現場，二人因此而相識。細菌人正在欺負人的時候，被苦瓜人教訓了一頓。細菌人心有不甘，於是想出了一個奸計來陷害苦瓜人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 香港公立醫院推行「腹膜透析(洗肚)優先制度」，節省資源且適合多數人，但是少數患者不適合洗肚，例如有腹部手術史、嚴重腹膜炎風險、心血管不穩定等，若無法排入公立醫院血透(洗血)名額，又負擔不起私家醫院的治療費（大概2500-7500)，跨境血透是一個出路。

programme.desc: 大四喜出埠表演，若水、龔燁打算待樹根回來並告知移居某群島之事，此時卻偶然得知城安將返回吳旺達述職，尚善亦將要離開一段長時間。眾人認為樹仁並不可靠，擔心樹根乏人照顧，幸而仍有不少可靠之人可效勞，遂稍感放心。樹仁偷聽眾人談話，設法阻止眾人離開，卻因故改變主意，決定只出招對付若水與龔燁，還為此作出不少嘗試，但屢屢碰壁，並被虹豆沙湯遠得知。樹仁向沙湯遠道出他要阻止眾人離開的真正原因，並已想到解決方法……

programme.desc: 有方與紫遙陷入熱戀，惟慧蘭打從心底不喜歡紫遙。有方工作上失意，在紫遙的推波助瀾下，一心放下設計本業，投入投資大計，向慧蘭借錢，更向雅淇提議賣樓平分。雅淇忍不住罵醒有方，令他重拾初衷，婉拒紫遙的投資計劃，令他和紫遙關係破裂。紫遙直播時被黑粉攻擊，有方擔心紫遙，與其溝通時卻遭惡言相向，更惹來連串惡意騷擾。另邊廂，雅淇亦受牽連被迷暈綁架，幸有方及時前來營救。此時，神秘人正監視有方和雅淇……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 肝癌是香港第三大癌症殺手，死亡率更達八成。陳智仁教授指此症最主要成因是乙型肝炎，近年研究更揪出脂肪肝也是關鍵！腫瘤有可能壓逼橫隔膜，引起右肩與背部的痛楚？肝功能差，小便茶黃、眼白黃是徵兆。港大為肝癌做了不少研究，當中「先縮後除」方案療效明顯，醫療過程三步曲全公開。至於以「肝立方」新技術試藥，可為病人針對性訂立治療藥物組合。另外，陳教授建議乙肝帶菌者及脂肪肝患者每六個月接受相關檢查，為何要這樣頻密？

programme.desc: 神秘人令有方明白紫遙失蹤只是躲藏避債。有方察覺家中異象，雅淇更在半夢半醒間看見一身穿裙褂的詭異女子，似是紫遙邪術作祟。有方主動接送保護雅淇，陪她到圍村做資料搜集，雅淇在古宅內見到詭異女子所穿的裙褂！雅淇通過前世回溯，揭開一段牽涉少爺、新娘、童養媳的民初時代愛恨情仇，與有方開始懷疑紫遙是童養媳轉世，一再糾纏二人。有方和雅淇報警，欲徹底解決騷擾事件，同時警方接報指找到紫遙失車，不排除紫遙可能遇害……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 案例主角曾接受幽門螺旋菌測試呈陰性，仍確診胃癌第三期，外科醫生指沒有幽門螺旋菌就不會患胃癌屬謬誤！醫生提醒胃酸倒流可能引起慢性食道炎，甚至演變成胃癌或食道癌。經常食宵夜、長期進食醃製食物，也是胃癌成因之一。根治胃癌需切除部份或整個胃部，現時科技可透過微創外科與機械人進行。譚俊彥走進手術室，直擊手術過程。醫學院院長亦提到，人工智能科技日益成熟，有助優化胃癌的診治成效；梁凱晴另會了解腹腔化療的資訊。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#3粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語堅決離婚，逼予誠簽下協議將投資收益平分，但卻在狂歡一夜後被告知予誠的投資虧光了。翹琪推薦蜜語到浦榮應徵，但因其無工作經驗，只能從底層房務員做起。紀封以黑卡貴賓身分住進浦榮，發現酒店存在各種問題…

programme.title: 再創世紀#11粵
programme.desc: 令翹接手修改程凱做的計劃書，完成後二人與澤雨一同慶祝，竟忘了叫小慧。澤雨與定垚出席朋友婚禮，因悶壞而悄悄離開，回想昔日時光又大跳手指舞。澤雨在董事會上受挫，再被松蔭教訓，到咖啡店遇上來港追夢的曲端兒，得知她參加了創業比賽。明晞積極幫忙智健的自由衣櫃計劃，天生提醒此舉破壞活化計劃，明晞忐忑。思妤婉拒追求者約會，好友Karen好言相勸。物流工人不滿公司的苛刻待遇，代表傅建業發起按章工作，影響傲堂運作。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 子宮內膜癌的病例近年呈上升趨勢，婦科腫瘤科醫生指與飲食習慣、未生育比例上升等原因有關。不正常陰道出血等早期徵狀與其他婦科病相似，醫生建議高危人士及早求醫，並帶來診治資訊。夏季天氣炎熱，外出用膳時的食物安全尤為重要。專家建議揀選持有食環署牌照的餐廳，如有國際標準的食品安全認證更佳。港人愛吃自助餐，用餐時有何要注意？此外，專家亦細說打邊爐時可怎樣避免交叉污染。「睇餸食飯」，鄭紫欣示範「日式家庭牛丼」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃深圳粵
programme.desc: 眾吃貨走進蛇口市場掃平海鮮，購入北寄貝、鮑魚、蟶子等，然後往餐廳加工，再加點乳鴿、南瓜包等，埋單約一千元人民幣。品嚐香滑「薑撞奶」，凱晴、慧中還親手試做。到超市買海鮮加工吃是遊深圳熱門行程，可會有伏？享用星級素菜，除用上多款矜貴菇菌外，菜式的精緻造型亦令人不自覺要相機食先！一探被笑稱是被卡拉OK耽誤的美食餐廳，K房內竟吃到「黑松露蒸水蛋」？美顏養生火鍋，將多種野生菇菌與土雞共冶一爐，女主持們大愛。

programme.title: 東坡家事#13粵PG
programme.desc: 東坡走訪刑部追查洩題事件。小妹遇劫，徐淑眉為救小妹受傷昏迷，甦醒後失憶。晚上淑眉找小妹相伴，小妹展示送少游的簪花，其後遍尋不獲。東坡喬裝追查洩題事件；行雷閃電晚上，淑眉潛入東坡書房，驚見他站在門外……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#151粵
programme.desc: 悅如承認誤傳懷孕，要付千萬違約金。拍攝宣傳照時，朋與悅出盡計謀才不致令真相曝光。眾欲公開事實，並作出賠償，卻又發覺款項遠遠不夠，更以為麗帶來的鈔票是偽鈔。根最後兵行險著，決定帶兩人偷渡至馬達加斯加。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 大月士兵被一網打盡，謝危與燕臨父子將芷衣平安帶回。薛國公將謝危矯詔一事告訴聖上，要定謝危和燕家謀反叛國之罪，聖上說此事事關重大，要再查證。芷衣認為謝危對雪寧必有別的心思，又問雪寧隨他過來又是什麼心意。

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 傳統的民族歌曲旋律簡單，既可以澎湃雄壯的聲線歌頌國家，亦能透過優美的歌詞抒解離鄉之愁。擅唱中華色彩歌曲的張明敏作客《靚聲王》，聯同張崇基、張崇德、許秋怡、胡琳、何雁詩，用歌聲演繹一段段鄉土「龍」情。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.desc: 溢致電公司熱線求助，接線生Sugar有甜美聲線，令溢對她留有好印象。溢到電腦店拿取已訂的軟件，卻被坐輪椅之女子捷足先登，因而起衝突，該女子更用輪椅輾其腳。溢再得Sugar幫助，令溢對其更添好感。

programme.desc: 謝危為救姜雪寧，假意答應平南王，給燕牧去信請他帶兵南下。燕家軍捷報連連，平南王甚為滿意，同意謝危辦端午宴的提議。呂顯分析謝危的來信，破解出暗藏訊息。端午宴上，平南王卻要謝危親自毀掉姜雪寧的手以示忠心…

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃深圳粵
programme.desc: 把原條江團魚放進石鍋，煮出奶白色的鮮甜湯底，成為滋味火鍋，吃貨們食得滿足。位於南山區花卉中心的咖啡店，令人仿如置身法國的庭園景致，吸引女士們瘋狂打卡。日式餐廳選用鰻魚、鵝肝等炮製和風Taco，還有海膽配牛角包，難怪女生不顧儀態張嘴享用。掃食寶安區的夜市一條街，眾吃貨將鉢鉢雞串燒、黑色臭豆腐、花甲粉、荊州鍋盔等小食，統統掃入肚中。這集還會「開箱」存倉式超市的人氣急凍烤鴨與漢堡，秀怡讚CP值甚高！

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 一個寒冷的夜晚，市民耗電量隨之大增。一座發電廠出現故障，加上種種巧合重疊，導致全市鎮陷入大停電！沈武與兩兄妹被困在商場的升解機，孫女茱爾收到求救，立即與智悟等人前往救援，卻遭逢道路大塞車……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 今集「WORKOUT 2GETHER」動動身體之餘，亦訓練一下拍子感。第一節先是跟節奏拍掌及拍大腿，拍的次數還會有所變化；踢腿也可加入打拍子元素。微蹲移動配合手部揮動的動作，都有助訓練全身肌力。第二節腿部練習，融入模仿動物的元素，為運動提升趣味性，讓小朋友更易投入。蹲下扮鴨仔四處走，並嘗試轉圈。扮猩猩時，手部變得「忙碌」？隨後速度放慢，化身成樹懶。扮兔仔要不停踢腳；模仿熊爬行，還能鍛練平衡力。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 對於出身演藝世家的識邊燎來說，愛麗絲比亞是一個讓她自由自在，不被他人特別看待的夢幻國度。為了守護這片樂土，她竭盡全力仍會在所不惜。與此同時，由於三公主的多番阻撓，史納樂隊終於動上真格。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 過去政府曾採取多項措施，包括增加直接資助額，提供校舍或優惠批地的方式，鼓勵發展優質私校，讓家長在考慮子女學業時，除了主流的官校同津校外，會有更多選擇，不過，政府的措施是否足以令大部分私校，脱離目前所面對的困境？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1998年專題。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2862粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 尚善等人有不少發現，擔心眾人離開後，樹根的生活會出現問題，都想將他留在自己身邊。眾人分別將要出埠工作，都提出可偕樹根同行，樹根遂讓眾人安排行程，輪流前赴不同地方旅行散心，率先跟樹仁前赴非洲拍攝動物，繼而隨城安轉往吳旺達，再與尚善、潮偉到內地遊玩，本以為過程優遊寫意，怎料令他吃盡苦頭。若水、龔燁帶同樹根到二人即將移居的群島生活，為樹根安排不少驚喜，樹根生活自在，此時下了一個重大決定……

programme.title: 森下仁丹Bifina Si 益生菌呈獻：非份之罪#24粵PG
programme.desc: 警方翻看紫遙半個月來的直播片，推斷有人以deepfake技術冒充紫遙……有方、雅淇再往圍村探尋前世，得知新娘婚後不久便急病而死，似是童養媳與相士合謀所害。有方對是誰冒充紫遙有頭緒，誘導對方開直播，終令警方確認疑兇身份，再對該人發通緝令。雅淇被疑兇刺傷，而疑兇亦似是畏罪自殺，一切像是告一段落，惟紫遙父蕭邦澤在工作室發現一物……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 免疫系統能協助打擊壞細胞，患上「原發性免疫缺陷病」，如紅斑狼瘡，好細胞或會被「認錯」而受攻擊，病因多為基因突變。港大醫學院近年的臨床研究，抽取病人的血細胞後「變」為幹細胞，並擴展成不同細胞或類器官，再藉測試得出針對式的治療方案。這類病人過往需每月入院輸入免疫球蛋白補充劑；凱晴探訪棟篤笑藝人阿V，了解「皮下注射」新技術如何改善病友的生活質素。醫生提醒要留意免疫缺陷的警告信號SPUR，各字母代表甚麼？

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#4粵普

programme.desc: 「世界劍擊錦標賽2026 中國香港」，7月下旬在亞洲博覽館舉行。劍擊世錦賽第一次由本港主辦，是奧運以外最高級別的劍擊賽事，雲集全球逾120個國家及地區的頂尖劍手，角逐男子、女子個人及團體花劍、重劍與佩劍各個項目的冠軍殊榮。TVB翡翠台透過焦點直擊、精華簡報，緊貼這屆劍尖上的刺激比拼！

programme.title: 再創世紀#12粵
programme.desc: 物流工潮繼續，克網揭發傲堂高層與貴成運輸之間的利益關係，天生請纓與代表傾談，想藉此事控制定垚。程凱打入創業比賽最後十強，向街坊眾籌。端兒指責程凱抄襲其理念，又向澤雨投訴，沒想到令程凱的程式人氣急升。定垚決定與建業傾談，永成故意阻撓。財經小說家萬敬賢採訪工潮工人，期間建業被工人指責拿了高層的好處。智健得知明晞收賣三婆兒子令她放棄檔口，與明晞鬧翻。學禮引導敬賢利用小說攻擊傲堂，高哲欲拉攏永成逼走定垚。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 《流行都市》為觀眾介紹時令產品、健康養生、健體運動、護膚化妝、時尚服飾、嬰幼兒護理、育兒知識、城中美食、飼養寵物等潮流資訊，內容包羅萬有！主持們親身體驗、示範或測試之外，還會邀請嘉賓帶來相關專業知識。烹飪環節方面，多位手勢了得的廚藝專家輪流登場，示範簡單美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解決煮食煩惱。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃深圳粵
programme.desc: 把原條江團魚放進石鍋，煮出奶白色的鮮甜湯底，成為滋味火鍋，吃貨們食得滿足。位於南山區花卉中心的咖啡店，令人仿如置身法國的庭園景致，吸引女士們瘋狂打卡。日式餐廳選用鰻魚、鵝肝等炮製和風Taco，還有海膽配牛角包，難怪女生不顧儀態張嘴享用。掃食寶安區的夜市一條街，眾吃貨將鉢鉢雞串燒、黑色臭豆腐、花甲粉、荊州鍋盔等小食，統統掃入肚中。這集還會「開箱」存倉式超市的人氣急凍烤鴨與漢堡，秀怡讚CP值甚高！

programme.title: 東坡家事#14粵PG
programme.desc: 淑眉見少游後昏倒，醒來記起所有事。東坡拿出少游休書，淑眉否認收過，後留下紙條離開。皇上派少游作監丞，少游卻想任地方通判。東坡在御前唸起《江城子》，蘇轍向皇上解釋兄長思念亡妻，閏之聞東坡詩詞後心情低落。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#152粵
programme.desc: 溢致電公司熱線求助，接線生Sugar有甜美聲線，令溢對她留有好印象。溢到電腦店拿取已訂的軟件，卻被坐輪椅之女子捷足先登，因而起衝突，該女子更用輪椅輾其腳。溢再得Sugar幫助，令溢對其更添好感。

programme.title: 命轉皇后#27粵普PG
programme.desc: 謝危為救姜雪寧，假意答應平南王，給燕牧去信請他帶兵南下。燕家軍捷報連連，平南王甚為滿意，同意謝危辦端午宴的提議。呂顯分析謝危的來信，破解出暗藏訊息。端午宴上，平南王卻要謝危親自毀掉姜雪寧的手以示忠心…

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 今集邀來丁子朗、鄧佩儀、江嘉敏、余德丞四位年輕俊男美女，連帶Do姐開場時亦活潑起來。台灣高雄超市食米區內一部像洗衣機的機器，究竟有何用處？現場美食題，兩隊享用名廚炮製的「水晶凍」後，競猜其主要食材；有嘉賓竟嘗試用美男計「色誘」Do姐「放水」，公正嚴明的Do姐當然不會妥協！北海道的函館朝市以新鮮海產聞名，「問題專員」入內品嚐三文魚一處刁鑽部位，「食得有幾招積」？兌換貨幣環節出現逆轉勝，詳情如何？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 《果欄中的江湖大嫂》的「大巴」陳煒和「小巴」岑麗香，分別與農夫二人組成「美女與野獸」拍檔， C君卻稱跟香香有溝通困難？在曼谷，不少善心人把汽水拉環投進捐款箱，是甚麼原因？Do姐「貼士」大贈送，兩組當然要拿出「雙倍積分」錦囊！鄺潔楹介紹在東京的清酒新飲法，會在酒中加添甚麼？韓國情侶原來不會請對方吃雞翼，有何忌諱？積分兌換獎金環節，其中一個地方主要出口糧食，香香竟錯說成「零食」，引來全場爆笑！

programme.title: 蜂蜜山丘事件簿(完)
programme.desc: 位於海邊的蜂蜜山丘是個友好的社區，但常常發生神秘且無法解釋的事件，幸好有天才偵探貓頭鷹索菲，和她年輕的助手松鼠奇普，針對所有大大小小的事件展開調查！

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.desc: 全新場景、全新比賽陣容、全新遊戲並結合世界各國的場景與關卡。考驗麻吉好友和團體的合作默契，一場場歡笑、緊張與刺激的團體競賽，陪伴大朋友小朋友週末的歡聚時光。

programme.title: 我們，家
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 我們，家
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 好搭檔(完)
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 我們，家
programme.desc: 【金喜善陷入家庭危機！神秘女子揭露家族秘密】心理學博士兼知名人物英媛與家人過著幸福生活，直到神秘女子世娜的出現引發連鎖事件。公公意外身亡，丈夫在振與世娜失蹤，揭露他們的不倫關係。在尋找丈夫的過程中，英媛發現世娜是心理變態，曾殺死三個前夫。同時，兒子道賢也坦承與學校前輩素伊有了孩子。家庭的秘密逐漸浮出水面，英媛必須面對現實，守護家人並解開所有的謎團。

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 現在開始是Showtime！
programme.desc: 【操縱幻術的魔術師朴海鎮×通靈女警秦基周，靈異喜劇Showtime！！】神秘又搞怪的魔術師車次雄，不僅能操縱幻術，還能使喚鬼魂，這群「幽靈助手」是他的得力夥伴。熱血女警高瑟海，擁有通靈能力，她對靈異現象毫不畏懼。兩人因一起調查超自然案件而結盟，一邊與鬼神合作，一邊大展魔術與正義力量。當喜劇、靈異與調查結合，愛情與真相也心動牽引。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.desc: Hyundai Cup 2026 is the 16th ASEAN Championship, the biennial international men's football championship of Southeast Asia organised by the ASEAN Football Federation (AFF) and will be the 1st edition under the name ASEAN Hyundai Cup. The format of the knockout round remains unchanged, with semi-finals and the final played on two-leg format.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Christopher getsstuck in cement

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BUILDING BLOCKS, FALLING TOWERS – ROOKIE AND THE MOLE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large box full of building blocks. He starts building towers, but they keep collapsing whenever he looks away. He discovers a hole in the ground with nothing inside, but curious as ever, he presses a button to inflate himself and blows into one of the holes, causing the troublemaker, a friendly mole, to pop out. Rookie catches his new friend , and together they set up an amazing building.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - HAPPY BIRTHDAY TOOO YOUUUUU! ROOKIE AND THE BIRTHDAY BASH
programme.desc: In the final episode of the second season, Rookie hears suspicious noises and begins to investigate. But he can‘t find the source! When he finally opens a door, he is greeted by a confetti cannon - a surprise birthday party! All his friends are gathered around a cake with two candles, and at the little turtle’s count, they all join in singing ‘Happy Birthday’ together!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos - Jacarevis e Amigos - Show do Jacarelvis
programme.desc: O Jacarelvis tenta fazer um show quando uma abelhinha aparece em seu caminho, esse imprevisto pode se tornar uma grande parceria!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos - Jacarevis e Amigos - Escovo os dentes

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos - Jacarevis e Amigos - Minha Escola
programme.desc: Uma homenagem bem didática ao segundo lar de muitas crianças!

programme.desc: O Mico Tuco te cutuca nesse rockabilly que não vai deixar ninguém parado!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos - Jacarevis e Amigos - Jacare Careca
programme.desc: Uma divertida cantiga que brinca com a sonoridade do nome dos animais.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.desc: Oh no, Jeremy ran out of gas! Troy selects the most perfect truck to refuel him: Tyson the Tanker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Francis the Forklift helps at the construction site
programme.desc: Edgar made a mess at the construction site! Troy selects the best truck to help with the clean-up: Francis the Forklift!

programme.desc: Tyler stole some candy from Baby Francis! Troy selects the bravest, fastest car to stop him: Matt the Police Car!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S07 - N
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'n', and we go on an adventure around the sound. We see a nest, some noses and a net, and watch some newts eat noodles at night!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S01 - Vivienne Blows Her Top
programme.desc: Messy and his friends have animals to save and eruptions to stop in OKIDO when Vivienne Volcano gets a rumbly tummy. Oh dear!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - The Sticky Sauce Situation
programme.desc: Fabio's yummy new sauce is so sticky that he gets stuck to Mojo's bonnet. They have to do everything together until Bo figures out how to 'unsticky' that sauce!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Family Meeting
programme.desc: When Dad's accused of 'fluffing' in Bluey's face as he climbed out of bed, he's put on trial with Mum as the judge, and Bluey and Bingo as witnesses. Bluey might also have to explain what she was doing there.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night and Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Takeaway
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment, pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Fancy Restaurant
programme.desc: Bingo and Bluey want mum and dad to smoochy kiss, so they set up a romantic evening for two at their fancy restaurant. Everything goes to plan, until chef Bingo's special arrives.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - River Chub
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to North America in search of a river chub that builds an underwater nest with over 7000 pebbles.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Mythical Creature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Puzzle Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Training Badge
programme.desc: Duggee struggles to organise the Squirrels in order of height and keeping them focused on the task. Sounds like the Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Eiffel Tower, France
programme.desc: The Go Jetters try to fix the Eiffel tower after Grandmaster Glitch breaks it while using it as a TV aerial.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Go Jet Academy: Birthday Surprise
programme.desc: The Go Jetters face their toughest mission yet: organising a birthday party for Ubercorn without him finding out! Luckily, when Glitch and Ubercorn were cadets together, they made a map of all the secret passages around the Academy. The Go Jetters can use it to avoid detection while they prepare the party. programme.desc: Nia uses what she learns about lighthouses to suggest covering a big wheel in Christmas lights, so that Harold can see where he's going in a storm.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Garden Gaming
programme.desc: Duck is getting frustrated with his new computer game, so Sarah builds a version he can play.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Seacow Snow Trail
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck have received some Christmas Presents and are keen to find out who delivered them.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Noisy Night
programme.desc: There's a funny noise around town. It's distracting the children's music practice and keeping everyone else up. Stanley investigates with the help of Myrtle.

programme.desc: Stanley helps Hattie, Fred, and Fifi with a new food delivery service. It starts well, except with each delivery a problem arises. Stanley must solve them before Myrtle's party.

programme.desc: JoJo thinks she's seen every animal that visits Cynthia's garden. But Cynthia shows JoJo her new night-time camera, which can take photos of nocturnal animals JoJo has never seen. Gran Gran has a plan to help JoJo discover these night-time animals - they can leave a footprint tracker out overnight outside her house to find out which ones visit them. programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal car's wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play 'Driving', Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tina
programme.desc: Tired of being told what to do, Bluey and Bingo enlist their giant invisible friend Tina to show Mum and Dad who's boss. Now they can do anything they want, until Mum and Dad rebel.

programme.desc: The Squirrels are at the Clubhouse playing, but they can't stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Luckily, Duggee has his dream badge and can help the Squirrels work out what they mean. As the Squirrels think about dreams, all the different dreams of the Clubhouse friends become weirder and more wonderful. We even get to see Duggee's dream!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Rainbow Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out walking around in the rain with Duggee and notice a rainbow! But before they know it, it's gone and the Squirrels are devastated. They decide to make their own rainbow and go off in search of all the colours from everything around them, including strawberries, carrots and bananas. Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

Duggee shows the Squirrels what he has been working on too - a rainbow cake!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - Loch Ness, Scotland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to Scotland in search of the Loch Ness Monster, but Grandmaster Glitch plans to catch Nessie first, if only his Grimbler was up to the job.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Spinach
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the exceptional painter, Spinach, creating Kiwi's portrait, if Kiwi can keep still.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Chicory
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Chicory running the show backstage and singing about how she, the Belgian Endive, was discovered in the song "Chicory, Dickory, Dock!"

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Dragon Boat Beats
programme.desc: It's a special day in the veggie aisle because it's the Dragon Boat Race Festival on Ice. The Supermarket is frozen over and Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Tomato practice for the boat race by using chopsticks for oars, but it doesn't go well as they're out of sync with each other. Evil Pea arrives with the Cobs, who are rowing in great sync. Evil Pea says they're going to beat Supertato in the race, and they row away leaving Supertato's boat behind. Can Supertato help his team to row in harmon

programme.title: Supertato S01 - How to be a Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids a Supertato training film, but Evil Pea sneaks in to take over Tato Tower. The Grape Kids use the rug launcher to eject Evil Pea out of the tower.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Lights Out
programme.desc: When the lights go out in Home Dome, the Teletubbies get the giggles! The lights come back on again and there's Tubby Custard mess everywhere.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the “walls”?

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return…

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue…

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies…

programme.title: Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: Hua, a clever beauty, teams up with her brother to stage a jewel heist and plans to sell the loot in Singapore. To evade customs, she slips a diamond ring into the pocket of a fellow passenger, Zhang Zhi Xian, only to lose him after landing. Forced to track him down, Hua resorts to a series of clumsy schemes to get close and retrieve the ring.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - “Black Leopard”. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of “Black Leopard”, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: A young swordswoman Fang Ying Qi sets out to join the Flying Dragon Clan in their defense against the invading Jin forces. Fang also intends to avenge the murder of her parents by bandit leader Han 20 years ago. Han has since taken on a false identity as a member of the Flying Dragon Clan and Fang must rely on her deadly sword skills to stop Han.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her…

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keeper's daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…
